title: AI1 1-day attack-free survival after red comes within 120px, 100 paired seeds

methodology.definition: survived=alive without red strike for 1 in-game day; hit=red strikes green during window; diedOther=green dies without red strike; unresolved=window not finished at DAY100
methodology.independentEpisodes: one exposure on entry into <=120px; no rearm until no red within 120px; attacks before green update also trigger/resolve an exposure
methodology.control: clone copies parent weights without mutation; same initial neural distribution
